name: Toyota technical with SPG-9
protection: Unarmoured. Game rule still treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire. SPG-9 HEAT counts as a launcher hit against vehicles (game proposal).
visual_notes: Pickup with SPG-9 tripod or pedestal mounted in the bed, barrel pointing forward over the cab
Backblast area kept clear; ammo tubes stacked in the bed
